text:
Maria K: release-bot just posted the publish for v2.4.8 to PyPI and npm, but CI for mac wheels failed signature check :warning:
release-bot: publish succeeded (artifacts: psf wheels, npm tarball). logs: `upload complete`, `signing OK`
Samir D: seeing the failure on our macos-smoke job — installer fails with `invalid wheel signature` when running pip install from test env :eyes:
Alex P: hmm, that started after the license header tweak legal asked us to add. possibly changes the binary metadata that our signing tool hashes?
Zara L: confirming: legal added a multiline attribution block into C-extension headers. We didn't re-run `gpg --sign` step after that.
Maria K: ok risk assessment: if signature mismatch is true, we should not expose this to hosted customers. proposal: yank v2.4.8 from PyPI and pin the published dist tag to v2.4.7 for now. also hold npm dist-tag `latest` back to 2.4.7.
Samir D: +1 to yank. What's our rollback procedure? Need commands and a short checklist so oncall can act fast.
Alex P: checklist: 1) PyPI yank (maintainer account): `twine remove mypkg 2.4.8` 2) Re-tag npm: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/mypkg@2.4.7 latest` 3) Re-open release PR to fix signing + re-run wheel build on mac runners 4) update release notes and the incident log.
Zara L: also update the console routing rule for hosted customers to prefer model-serving-sdk@2.4.7 for 24h — quick mitigation. I'll open a console config change.
Maria K: Samir, can you execute the yank and npm tag? I'll prepare a short rollback message for the changelog and customer-notice draft. If anything blocks, call me.
Samir D: executing PyPI yank now. will also add a note in release thread: `held due to signature mismatch`
(devex-bot): reminder: create postmortem if customers affected > 10 or outage >30m
release-bot: npm dist-tag updated (latest -> 2.4.7)
Samir D: PyPI remove succeeded. I also added a note to the release PR and pinned the internal mirror to 2.4.7. :lock:
Alex P: thanks. I'll re-run the signing flow locally with the new header and post a failing log in the PR. If we can re-sign artifacts without code changes, we can re-publish as 2.4.8-hotfix and push a small note in release notes.
Maria K: excellent. Next: update CHANGELOG.md with `BREAKING: rolled back 2.4.8 publish due to packaging/signature; republishing as 2.4.8-hotfix after re-sign` and send customer advisory template. I'll ping @support to pre-draft.
Zara L: pre-draft in #support ready, attaching snippet: "We briefly published v2.4.8 but rolled back due to packaging signature verification. No runtime behavior changes expected. Use v2.4.7. We will republish a signed hotfix shortly."
Samir D: putting a 2 hour freeze on publishes to avoid accidental re-publishes. will unlock when hotfix published.
Maria K: thanks team. follow-ups: Alex to post signing logs + hotfix tag, Zara to update console routing, Samir to lift freeze after republish, I'll send customer advisory. Close thread when hotfix confirmed. :shipit:
